fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-03-02 (evening, 18:40): Harish Mani, aged 18, a college student, did not return after leaving for a temple visit; last known location was near Vetri Nagar Shopping Complex. The complaint was lodged by Vidhya Krishnan (9000000069), a family member of Harish Mani. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Mobile phone allegedly switched off shortly after leaving the campus area.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, shopping complex, CCTV, evening
